## Summary
Describe the change and link the issue (Closes #...).

## Scope
- [ ] Car
- [ ] Scooter
- [ ] Both

## Verification
- [ ] Tests added/updated
- [ ] `dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed lib test`
- [ ] `flutter analyze`
- [ ] `flutter test`
- [ ] Screenshots for UI changes
- [ ] No private vehicle/location/finance data
- [ ] Documentation and migrations updated where needed

## Release impact
Breaking changes, permissions, API dependencies, migration and rollback notes.

## Approval
Maintainer review required before merge. No store publishing from contributor PRs.
